There was nothing particularly French about the 1970s-style brick house Chloe Tozer Clissold and her husband, Jack, found in Queensland’s Peregian Beach. ⁠
⁠
The bones were good; the personality was still up for negotiation. Twelve months later, the couple had Villa des Fleurs, a Mediterranean-inspired retreat that feels a world away from the home they first encountered.⁠
⁠
Tap the 🔗 in our bio to read the story. ⁠

This small worker’s cottage has been beautifully transformed by award-winning architect Kreis Grennan (kreisgrennanarchitecture) to keep the intimacy and charm of the original home while also making it feel unexpectedly bold 😍
 
Think playful pops of colour, natural light, high ceilings and a showstopping chef’s kitchen – what a dream!
 
📍 82 O’Neill Street, Lilyfield NSW 2040
 
Tap the 🔗 in our bio to see more of this listing.

There’s more than meets the eye at this home! 👀 Behind the doors of this Victorian brick cottage lies a contemporary residence architecturally designed by Coy Yiontis (coyyiontis) with interiors by Kimberley Wiedermann (kimberleywiedermann) of Accolade Design.⁠
⁠
Together they have designed a home that is elevated, warm and lavish 😍⁠
⁠
📍 113 Raglan Street, South Melbourne VIC 3205⁠
💰 Price guide: $4,000,000 - $4,400,000⁠
⁠
Tap the 🔗 in our bio to see more of this listing.⁠

‘Mountain Springs’ was brought to life by architect Scott Buscall of DesignStudioGroup (designstudiogroup), creating a home among the mountains that features contemporary finishes built to the highest standards with state-of-the-art technology throughout.
 
This residence has breathtaking views and is so peaceful, you feel like you’re in your own world 😍
 
📍 368D Bunkers Hill Road, Barrengarry NSW 2577

Down a quiet country road in Kincumber, on the NSW Central Coast, Seafarm nestles into rolling hills, its low-lying form catching dazzling ocean glimpses. Discreetly embedded in the landscape, the home feels at ease, as though it has always stood there.⁠
⁠
That strong sense of belonging was central to the project from the outset. What began as a plan to renovate the existing farmhouse, also called Seafarm, soon grew into a far more ambitious project.⁠
⁠
Tap the 🔗 in our bio to read the story. ⁠

‘Kaikoura’ is a c1840 home, and is one of few houses that captures Balmain’s history. With a current guide of $5.5m, this property enjoys stunning north-easterly views of the Harbour Bridge from all three levels.⁠
⁠
Significant architectural features have been beautifully preserved, including fireplaces, rich timber floors, and iron lacework. It would be the perfect place to watch the harbour on a summer’s day 😎⁠
⁠
📍 2 School Street, Balmain East NSW 2041⁠
